content: This mattress has been a horrendous disappointment, barely lasting a year before completely failing. The "medium-firm" description is an outright lie; it sagged dramatically within months, creating an indent where I sleep. It traps heat like a furnace, leaving me waking up in a sweat every single night. The off-gassing smell was so overpowering it took weeks to dissipate, even with extensive airing. My back pain has significantly worsened since switching to this lump of foam. Turning over feels like climbing out of a canyon, and forget about finding a comfortable position. I honestly regret this purchase more than almost any other in recent memory. Save your money and your spine; look elsewhere for a decent night's sleep.
